# Accessibility audit (Addy Osmani)

Audit and fix web accessibility issues against WCAG 2.2.

- Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills/main/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md
- Author: Addy Osmani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/accessibility-audit-addy-osmani-016794c9

Teaches Claude to check and improve accessibility using the WCAG 2.2 principles (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust). It covers keyboard navigation, screen readers, alt text, contrast, forms and focus, lists common issues by impact, and shows how to test with Lighthouse and axe-core. Reference files add detail.

**Try asking:**
- "Do an a11y audit on the checkout page"
- "Make this modal keyboard and screen reader accessible"
- "Are we WCAG 2.2 AA compliant?"
